summary: A direct / command of a managed turn now sends the tool wording (data-tool-presentation) ahead of its step, also when the approved command runs, so the chat names the tool by its label instead of its raw name. runDirectCommand takes it as the new option toolPresentation.
howTo: Nothing to do with createAiChatHandler: it passes the managed turn's wording. Without a managed turn there is no wording and no part is sent; the chat uses the app's toolLabels or the tool name, as before. An app that calls runDirectCommand itself can pass toolPresentation: { locale, tools: { [modelName]: { label } } }; it is written as a transient data-tool-presentation part right after start.
